scoringPolicy: No universal cut scores, numeric mastery thresholds, or automated pass/fail decisions are approved in this draft.
feedbackPolicy: Feedback should identify the task or process criterion, invite learner interpretation, and support a next-step decision. Do not use a single real-time score as proof of retained learning.

criteria.descriptor: Identifies the functional sections and their order in a musical example.
Creates or performs a coherent section sequence with clear transitions.
Explains one arrangement choice in relation to the intended musical effect.

profiles.retentionProbe: After a delay, outline the form of a previously studied piece without consulting the lesson.
profiles.transferProbe: Map or arrange the sections of an unfamiliar short piece.
profiles.cautions: Do not require one conventional song form; judge coherence against the learner's stated intent and musical context.

criteria.descriptor: Identifies the target interval from a controlled listening prompt.
Distinguishes interval direction and reproduces or locates the interval accurately.
Recognises the interval in a second key or musical context.

profiles.retentionProbe: Repeat a short interval-identification set in a later session without immediate answer cues.
profiles.transferProbe: Identify the same interval relationships in a different register or key.
profiles.cautions: Do not infer absolute-pitch ability from relative-interval tasks; specify the reference note and interval set.

criteria.descriptor: Captures the pitch sequence of a heard phrase with a playable guitar or notation representation.
Preserves the phrase's rhythmic contour and note order.
Checks and corrects the transcription against the source after an independent attempt.

profiles.retentionProbe: Reproduce or transcribe a previously studied short phrase after a delay without replaying it during the attempt.
profiles.transferProbe: Transcribe an unfamiliar phrase of similar length and difficulty.
profiles.cautions: Record replay limits, notation support, phrase length and whether pitch, rhythm or both are being assessed.

criteria.descriptor: Matches or identifies a target pitch relative to a stated reference.
Maintains the target pitch sufficiently for the task and notices drift.
Repeats pitch matching with a different reference or register.

profiles.retentionProbe: Match a new reference pitch in a later session without seeing a pitch display.
profiles.transferProbe: Match the pitch on a different string or with the voice rather than the original response method.
profiles.cautions: This profile assesses pitch matching, not absolute-pitch naming; any cents tolerance needs task-specific validation.

criteria.descriptor: Identifies the beat pattern and relevant subdivisions in a heard example.
Reproduces the rhythmic pattern with the intended accents and rests.
Maintains the pattern against a pulse in a second tempo or starting point.

profiles.retentionProbe: Recall and reproduce a short rhythm in a later session without hearing it immediately beforehand.
profiles.transferProbe: Reproduce a related rhythm at a different tempo or on a different musical texture.
profiles.cautions: Separate rhythm-pattern recognition from timing precision; do not score one as proof of the other.

criteria.descriptor: Uses the intended thumb/finger assignment for the selected pattern.
Maintains the pattern's order and pulse over a complete cycle.
Applies the pattern to a different chord or harmonic context without losing the pattern.

profiles.retentionProbe: Play a practised pattern in a later session without following a visual fingering prompt.
profiles.transferProbe: Apply the same pattern to a different chord progression or string set.
profiles.cautions: Pattern difficulty and tempo should be appropriate to the learner and the particular arrangement.

criteria.descriptor: Maintains the intended bass/thumb pulse while fingers play the upper notes.
Keeps bass and treble roles distinct without unintended interruptions.
Adapts the upper-note pattern while the thumb role remains stable.

profiles.retentionProbe: Perform the bass pattern with a familiar treble variation after a delay and without a prompt.
profiles.transferProbe: Keep the thumb pattern steady while changing the treble-note sequence.
profiles.cautions: Do not mistake a slow fixed pattern for independence; test coordination under a controlled variation.

criteria.descriptor: Locates requested natural notes on the specified strings and fret range.
Names the note accurately and explains or demonstrates the location strategy.
Repeats the task from a different starting string or fret.

profiles.retentionProbe: Complete a short note-location recall task after a delay without a reference chart.
profiles.transferProbe: Locate the same note names in an unpractised neck position.
profiles.cautions: State the fretboard range and tuning; do not generalise a small position task to full-neck fluency.

criteria.descriptor: Locates an octave-equivalent note from a given reference note.
Uses an appropriate octave shape or interval relationship accurately.
Transfers the octave relationship to another string pair or neck position.

profiles.retentionProbe: Find octave partners for a small set of reference notes after a delay.
profiles.transferProbe: Find octave equivalents using a different string pair or starting position.
profiles.cautions: Specify standard tuning assumptions and which octave shapes are in scope.

criteria.descriptor: Names the open strings or specified string/fret locations correctly.
Maps a requested note to a valid location within the stated range.
Uses the map to find a note from a different starting point.

profiles.retentionProbe: Complete a short string-and-fret recall task in a later session.
profiles.transferProbe: Locate a target note on a string or position not used in the original practice task.
profiles.cautions: Distinguish open-string naming from comprehensive note-location fluency.

criteria.descriptor: Forms the specified barre shape with the intended chord tones.
Produces the required strings clearly while controlling unwanted noise.
Changes to or from the shape in time within a short progression.

profiles.retentionProbe: Form and play the same barre family after a delay without a diagram prompt.
profiles.transferProbe: Move the shape to a different root or progression position.
profiles.cautions: Adapt expectations for hand size, instrument setup, partial-barre alternatives and physical comfort.

criteria.descriptor: Forms the specified open-position chord with the intended fretted and open notes.
Sounds the required strings clearly and controls unintended muted or buzzing strings.
Changes between selected open chords while maintaining the task's pulse.

profiles.retentionProbe: Play a previously learned open-chord sequence after a delay without a chord diagram.
profiles.transferProbe: Use the chord shapes in a different progression or strumming/fingerstyle context.
profiles.cautions: The identifier is reused widely; record chord family, voicing and context in the task rather than assuming all open-chord tasks are equivalent.

criteria.descriptor: Forms the required root-and-fifth shape at the specified position.
Mutes non-target strings and produces a controlled chord attack.
Moves between power-chord roots while maintaining the intended rhythm.

profiles.retentionProbe: Play a short power-chord movement after a delay without a shape diagram.
profiles.transferProbe: Transpose the movement to another root or string set.
profiles.cautions: Specify root string, octave, muting and rhythmic context.

criteria.descriptor: Identifies or constructs the specified seventh-chord quality from its formula or sound.
Selects a valid voicing containing the required chord tones.
Performs the voicing in a progression with the intended harmonic function.

profiles.retentionProbe: Identify or play the target chord quality in a later session without a formula prompt.
profiles.transferProbe: Construct or select the chord quality in a different key or progression.
profiles.cautions: Name the chord qualities assessed; do not treat one voicing as proof of broad seventh-chord fluency.

criteria.descriptor: Moves between the specified chord shapes with accurate fingering.
Maintains a continuous pulse through the change.
Produces the intended chord tones without avoidable gaps or excess noise.

profiles.retentionProbe: Repeat a short chord-change sequence after a delay without visual prompts.
profiles.transferProbe: Apply the movement strategy to a new chord pair or progression.
profiles.cautions: Record the chord pair, tempo and musical context; raw changes-per-minute is not sufficient evidence on its own.

criteria.descriptor: Identifies or constructs the requested triad quality and chord tones.
Plays a valid triad voicing or inversion on the stated string set.
Connects the voicing to a progression or musical phrase.

profiles.retentionProbe: Identify or play a previously studied triad/inversion after a delay.
profiles.transferProbe: Play the same triad quality in a different inversion, key or string set.
profiles.cautions: Specify chord quality, inversion, key and string set; do not equate memorising one grip with triad understanding.

criteria.descriptor: Identifies the voices or chord tones being connected between successive chords.
Uses common tones or small movements where appropriate to the intended progression.
Performs the progression with coherent voice movement and musical continuity.

profiles.retentionProbe: Re-create a previously studied voice-leading path after a delay without a fretboard diagram.
profiles.transferProbe: Connect a related progression using a different key or voicing.
profiles.cautions: The best movement depends on the progression, range, style and intended voicing; avoid a single universal shape.

criteria.descriptor: Supports the instrument securely with a stable, comfortable playing position.
Maintains workable access for both hands without avoidable gripping or strain.
Can sustain the setup through a short playing task and identify any discomfort.

profiles.retentionProbe: Set up independently at the start of a later session and self-check comfort.
profiles.transferProbe: Use the setup in both seated and standing contexts where relevant.
profiles.cautions: Use inclusive ergonomic guidance; body size, mobility, instrument type and accessibility needs affect the appropriate setup.

criteria.descriptor: Identifies the reference or target tuning before adjustment.
Adjusts the required strings toward the intended pitches without unsafe over-tightening.
Rechecks strings and verifies the tuning by a suitable method.

profiles.retentionProbe: Tune the instrument at a later session without step-by-step assistance.
profiles.transferProbe: Verify tuning using a different reference method or a small tuning deviation.
profiles.cautions: Specify standard or alternate tuning and reference pitch; any automatic tuner tolerance must be calibrated and tested.

criteria.descriptor: Plays the specified major-scale pattern with the correct note order.
Identifies the tonic and explains the whole-step/half-step structure relevant to the task.
Uses the pattern in a short phrase or in a second position/key.

profiles.retentionProbe: Play and name a previously learned major-scale fragment after a delay.
profiles.transferProbe: Apply the formula or pattern in a different key or fretboard position.
profiles.cautions: Specify key, register, position and whether the task assesses formula knowledge, fingering or musical application.

criteria.descriptor: Plays the specified major or minor pentatonic pattern with accurate note sequence.
Identifies the tonal centre and distinguishes the intended major/minor context.
Uses the pattern to create a coherent short phrase over a suitable backing or progression.

profiles.retentionProbe: Play a previously learned pentatonic shape after a delay without a fretboard prompt.
profiles.transferProbe: Use the pattern in a different key, position or backing progression.
profiles.cautions: Specify major vs minor, tonic, box/position and whether the criterion is scale recall or improvisational application.

criteria.descriptor: Shapes a phrase with intentional timing, dynamics, articulation and space.
Creates a recognisable beginning, development and ending for the musical idea.
Explains one expressive choice and its intended effect.

profiles.retentionProbe: Perform a short phrase after a delay and describe an intentional expressive choice.
profiles.transferProbe: Shape a new phrase over a different progression or style while retaining a clear musical intention.
profiles.cautions: Do not impose one stylistic interpretation; use context-sensitive descriptors and more than one acceptable musical solution.

criteria.descriptor: Interprets string and fret information accurately from the supplied tablature.
Preserves note order and any specified rhythmic or articulation symbols.
Performs or explains a short excerpt using the notation.

profiles.retentionProbe: Read a short previously studied tab excerpt after a delay without the lesson explanation.
profiles.transferProbe: Read an unfamiliar excerpt containing the same notation features.
profiles.cautions: State whether rhythm notation, bends, slides, legato or other symbols are included; tab alone may omit rhythm.

criteria.descriptor: Creates a usable recording of the specified performance task.
Identifies an audible strength and a specific improvement opportunity from playback.
Uses the review to choose a concrete next practice action.

profiles.retentionProbe: Repeat the recording/review process in a later session and compare the same stated criterion.
profiles.transferProbe: Apply the recording-and-review method to a different song, exercise or performance goal.
profiles.cautions: Separate the ability to operate recording tools from the musical quality of the recorded performance.

criteria.descriptor: Recognises a slip or interruption without abandoning the musical task.
Re-enters at a musically appropriate point and restores pulse or form.
Maintains continuity after recovery and reflects on the chosen recovery strategy.

profiles.retentionProbe: Demonstrate recovery after a controlled interruption in a later session.
profiles.transferProbe: Recover from a different type of slip or interruption in an unfamiliar short passage.
profiles.cautions: Assess the recovery behaviour, not the presence of the deliberately introduced mistake; allow different valid recovery strategies.

criteria.descriptor: Performs the agreed section or song with its main form and transitions intact.
Maintains continuity, pulse and the musical features required for the chosen level.
Identifies what is secure and what needs further learning using specific evidence.

profiles.retentionProbe: Perform the agreed passage after a meaningful delay without immediate rehearsal or prompts.
profiles.transferProbe: Perform the piece in a new context such as a different starting point, accompaniment or ensemble role.
profiles.cautions: Specify repertoire, section, permitted prompts, memory expectations and stylistic context; avoid equating song completion with mastery of every related skill.

criteria.descriptor: Controls unwanted ringing from non-target strings during the task.
Produces intended muted/percussive sounds or rests when required.
Maintains rhythmic placement while switching between sounding and muted notes.

profiles.retentionProbe: Repeat a muted rhythm pattern in a later session without a muting reminder.
profiles.transferProbe: Apply noise control or intentional muting in a different chord shape or rhythmic pattern.
profiles.cautions: Separate muting unwanted noise from creating intentional percussive sounds; they are related but distinct outcomes.

criteria.descriptor: Maintains a consistent beat through the defined playing task.
Keeps the pulse through rests, changes or simplified passages.
Recovers the beat after a deliberate pause or entry cue.

profiles.retentionProbe: Perform a short pulse task in a later session without a continuous metronome cue.
profiles.transferProbe: Maintain the pulse at a new tempo or within a different rhythmic texture.
profiles.cautions: Specify duration, tempo and allowed metronome support; do not equate metronome synchronisation with all aspects of musical time.

criteria.descriptor: Uses the intended downstroke/upstroke pattern for the task.
Places accents, rests and chord attacks in the correct rhythmic locations.
Maintains a steady accompaniment through the full progression.

profiles.retentionProbe: Play the pattern in a later session without a stroke-direction prompt.
profiles.transferProbe: Apply the same rhythmic pattern to a different chord progression or song context.
profiles.cautions: Specify pattern, meter, tempo and whether muting/dynamics are part of the assessed task.

criteria.descriptor: Identifies or counts the requested subdivisions relative to the beat.
Performs the subdivision with consistent placement and grouping.
Moves between two specified subdivision patterns without losing the pulse.

profiles.retentionProbe: Count or play the same subdivision family in a later session without a spoken prompt.
profiles.transferProbe: Apply the subdivision to a different rhythmic pattern or tempo.
profiles.cautions: Name the subdivisions in scope and distinguish counting/recognition from instrument execution.

criteria.descriptor: Uses the intended alternating down-up stroke sequence for the exercise.
Maintains even attack, timing and pick depth over the phrase.
Plans string crossings without unintended resets or loss of pulse.

profiles.retentionProbe: Perform a familiar alternate-picking cell after a delay without verbal stroke cues.
profiles.transferProbe: Use the picking sequence on a different string set, pattern or tempo.
profiles.cautions: Strict alternation is a task-specific technique choice; do not penalise a musically valid alternative unless the task explicitly trains alternate picking.

criteria.descriptor: Bends toward the specified target pitch with controlled intonation.
Sustains the target and controls the release or return.
Integrates the bend into a phrase with suitable timing and articulation.

profiles.retentionProbe: Repeat a previously learned bend target in a later session without a visual pitch cue.
profiles.transferProbe: Bend to a different interval or on another string while retaining pitch control.
profiles.cautions: Specify target interval, string, fret and context; automated pitch tracking must account for vibrato, attack and instrument range.

criteria.descriptor: Executes the specified hammer-on or pull-off with a clear intended pitch change.
Balances note volume and timing across picked and unpicked notes.
Maintains pulse and articulation through a short legato phrase.

profiles.retentionProbe: Play a familiar hammer-on/pull-off cell after a delay without a fingering prompt.
profiles.transferProbe: Apply the legato movement to a different string or phrase pattern.
profiles.cautions: State whether slides are included; the catalogue description currently centres on hammer-ons and pull-offs.

criteria.descriptor: Targets the intended next string accurately during the phrase.
Maintains timing and even note attack across string changes.
Controls unwanted contact or ringing while crossing adjacent or non-adjacent strings.

profiles.retentionProbe: Repeat a two-string crossing sequence in a later session without a picking-path prompt.
profiles.transferProbe: Apply the technique to a new string order or a wider skip pattern.
profiles.cautions: Specify pick/finger technique, string order and whether string-skipping is included; do not infer motion efficiency solely from audio.
